mirror_note: هذه نسخة مرآة محلية لمحتوى PR #7 (الفرع phase-6-browser-e2e-20261121). عند دمج PR #7 في GitHub، إن اختلفت نسخة الدمج عن هذه النسخة فنسخة الدمج هي المرجع — التعريف الرسمي للمصادر لا يتفرع.
note: Registry of OFFICIAL sources for reference geodetic data (vertical datum grids first, other reference data later). The registry records authority hierarchy and intake policy; it does NOT embed data and does NOT grant trust. Trust is earned at the reception gate (ADR-0007: check_upload then prove_file), never before it — there is no special fetch path for 'trusted' sites.

authority_hierarchy.primary: the authority that published the model/document itself; its statements define the model
authority_hierarchy.secondary_distribution: a distribution channel that republishes/converts the primary's artifacts; it documents formats and licenses but is NOT a replacement for the primary's authority
authority_hierarchy.literature: peer-reviewed or agency literature used to document limitations and conventions; it never substitutes for the primary's files

sources.organization: National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA), Office of Geodesy and Geophysics
sources.url_note: geograv section hosts EGM96/EGM2008 model documentation and grid files
sources.check_result: domain confirmed as NGA; page content was not machine-readable from the build environment (HTML conversion failed) — the specific model pages must be re-verified at intake, not assumed
sources.policy: grid bytes must be taken from here (or a distribution whose lineage back to here is documented) before any vertical-transformation claim

sources.url_note: repository for PROJ datum grids (PROJ 7+); grids served via cdn.proj.org
hosts: redistributed datum grids incl. vertical (geoid) grids
sources.check_result: repository confirmed: 'Repository for proj datum grids (for use by PROJ 7 or later)' with horizontal and vertical shift grids; specific EGM grid paths and their per-grid licenses were NOT visible in the page summary and must be confirmed at intake
sources.policy: acceptable distribution channel for formats/licensing; lineage to the primary (NGA) must be recorded per grid file

hosts: documented limitation: EGM96 coefficient sets ALONE are insufficient without the model's conventions and realization being documented
sources.citation_status: incomplete — bibliographic details must be completed at intake from the source record carried by PR #7; they must NOT be invented here
sources.policy: used to justify why coefficient-only answers are refused for vertical claims; not a source of grid bytes

intake_policy.gate: every byte from every source above goes through the standing reception gate (ADR-0007): check_upload for security, prove_file for structure — no exceptions, no trust shortcuts
intake_policy.registration: every verdict, including refusals, enters the tamper-evident provenance log with the fetch source and its license
intake_policy.hierarchy_rule: a secondary_distribution entry may document formats and licenses; only the primary's authority defines the model — disagreements resolve toward the primary
